meta.project: Nexteer Plant 78 Hot Zone CV joint line - digital twin (training simulator)
meta.policy: Six teaching faults reuse the fault/alarm pairings built for the HMI mimic; the pairings themselves are an educational inference (NV-022). Alarm texts and codes are verbatim from the extracted register (src/data/hmi-errors.json). Faults marked training-scenario have NO documented reaction plan: remedies are simulated actions (unforce/ack) and are never presented as the plant's official recovery.
meta.safetyDisclaimer: Educational training scenarios only. Verify against master controlled copies before operational use.

faults.label: Laser unit not ready

trigger.via: hmi fault "laserDisabled" (machine panel fault button / PLC force / sim condition)

alarm.text: LASER UNIT NOT READY, CYCLE START DISABLE (& EMPTY CYCLE START)

symptoms: laser unit not ready / marking disabled
parts arrive unmarked and are rejected at the reader (reader alarm HMI-032 is a separate fault)

reaction.note: No official reaction plan for this fault exists in the controlled sources; this remedy is a TRAINING SCENARIO and must not be presented as the plant's official recovery. Verify against master controlled copies before operational use.

steps.name: read the alarm
steps.instruction: The alarm text is verbatim from the extracted register (photographic evidence).

steps.name: check the machine on the 3D line
steps.instruction: Select the laser marking station on the 3D line; the machine panel shows the FORCED indicator for laser.enabled.

steps.name: clear the trigger (simulated)
steps.instruction: Unforce laser.enabled on the machine panel (or unforce-all on the PLC screens), watch the alarm clear and the FORCED indicator disappear. This is the simulated recovery condition - not a documented plant procedure step.

faults.label: Cracks appear on parts
faults.machine: MPI / METLab stations (off-line; not modelled as 3D machines)

trigger.via: educational trigger only: imported/CLI (no on-line sensor in the simulated line)

symptoms: visual crack indication (MPI) or METLab finding
no HMI alarm is claimed - detection is off-line per the register

reaction.note: Reaction follows the documented Crack Reaction Plan (GWI34417543) extracted as CR-000 + CR-001..CR-015; source order preserved.
